column1: # The brand file's other fields and the answer scripts/brand.sh lint gives
# for each value (tests/garden/brand-lint.sh reads it: one scratch brand
# per row, the field set to the value). Tab-separated:
# The answer is ok, or the rule of the field's finding: unknown (a table
# or key the reader does not know), shape, machine (a machine name other
# than the default brand's) or control ([control] is all six or none).
# A [control] row starts from a whole [control] table and sets the one key
# to the value; - leaves that key out. The reader in crates/k2-brand refuses
# the same shapes; the lint is stricter only on .. in look.icons.
